spine-webgl.js is from EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes, branch 3.8.
License: SPINE-LICENSE.
Local change: mask the signed byte in BinaryInput.readString to decode UTF-8
attachment names correctly. No asset names are changed by this correction.
Keep atlas-declared page dimensions when Unity ships downsampled textures,
so original region coordinates retain their intended normalized UVs.
Binary download failure callbacks report an error without reading responseText
from an arraybuffer XMLHttpRequest, so failed loads do not stall recovery.
Collapsed parent transforms retain finite local applied values. IK skips
non-invertible or zero-length scaled chains instead of dividing by zero;
zero animation scales remain unchanged and resume normal solving when expanded.
Polygon batches accumulate alpha separately from their RGB blend factors so
opaque scenes remain opaque and transparent canvas exports retain coverage.
